name: TextMorph
description: Seamless word and phrase morphing primitive that coordinates layout width transitions, baseline alignment, autoplay cycling, and manual step controls.
a11yNotes: Announces the active phrase via aria-live='polite' and exposes keyboard-focusable manual Prev/Next controls when manualControls is enabled.

propsApi.name: prefix
propsApi.description: Static leading text aligned to the morphing baseline.

propsApi.name: phrases
propsApi.description: Array of words or short phrases to morph between.

propsApi.name: blurTransition
propsApi.description: Optical blur radius during phrase crossfade.
